name: Employee advance - expense claim
script:
# Get today's date and month end date today_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today()) month_end_date = frappe.utils.get_last_day(today_date) # Calculate days left until month-end days_left = (month_end_date - today_date).days # For testing: run every day (change back to days_left == 5 once tested) if days_left == 5 : # Fetch all Employee Advances with claimed amount < advance amount employee_advances = frappe.get_all( "Employee Advance", filters={"docstatus": 1}, fields=["name", "employee", "employee_name", "advance_amount", "claimed_amount"] ) # Debug log frappe.log_error(f"Employee Advance Reminder: Found {len(employee_advances)} records") for adv in employee_advances: difference = (adv.advance_amount or 0) - (adv.claimed_amount or 0) if difference > 0: email = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", adv.employee, "company_email") if email: # Send formatted email frappe.sendmail( recipients=email, subject=f"Reminder: Pending Settlement for Employee Advance {adv.name}", message=f"""

Hello {adv.employee_name},

You have an outstanding Employee Advance of {adv.advance_amount:,.2f} and have only claimed {adv.claimed_amount:,.2f} so far.

Pending Difference: {difference:,.2f}

Please submit the Expense Claim before {month_end_date}, otherwise the amount will be deducted from your salary.

Advance Reference: {adv.name}


Thank you,
Accounts Team

""" )

name: New Year Bonus Month Reminder
script:
today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate()) if today.day == 1 and today.month == 1: employees = frappe.get_all( "Employee", filters={"status": "Active"}, fields=["employee_name", "user_id"] ) for emp in employees: if emp.user_id: frappe.sendmail( recipients=[emp.user_id], subject="Set Bonus Month for New Year", message=f""" Dear {emp.employee_name},

Please set the month for your bonus according to the new year.

Regards,
HR Team """ )

name: RM1
script: if doc.stock_entry_type == "Material Receipt": stock_entry_data = { "doctype": "Stock Entry", "stock_entry_type": "Material Issue", "company": doc.company, "posting_date": doc.posting_date, "posting_time": doc.posting_time, "set_warehouse": doc.set_warehouse, "items": [] } fresh_doc = frappe.get_doc("Stock Entry", doc.name) log_rows = [] for row in fresh_doc.items: raw_material = row.get("custom_raw_material_item") qty_before_loss = float(row.get("custom_qty_before_loss") or 0) item_code = row.get("item_code", "❓") custom_loss = row.get("custom_loss", "N/A") log_rows.append( f"Item: {item_code} | " f"Raw Material: {raw_material or '❌'} | " f"custom_qty_before_loss: {qty_before_loss} | " f"custom_loss: {custom_loss}" ) if raw_material and qty_before_loss > 0: item_doc = frappe.get_doc("Item", raw_material) warehouse = None for d in item_doc.get("item_defaults", []): if d.company == doc.company: warehouse = d.default_warehouse break if not warehouse: frappe.throw(f"🚫 Default warehouse not set for raw material item: {raw_material}") stock_entry_data_dict={ "item_code": raw_material, "qty": qty_before_loss, "s_warehouse": warehouse, "uom": item_doc.stock_uom, "stock_uom": item_doc.stock_uom, "conversion_factor": 1, "custom_qty_before_loss":qty_before_loss, "custom_loss":0 } stock_entry_data["items"].append(stock_entry_data_dict) # frappe.log_error("🧾 Stock Entry Item Batch Log", "\n".join(log_rows)) # frappe.log_error("📦 Final Payload", str(stock_entry_data_dict)) # ← Fixed this line if stock_entry_data["items"]: created_entry = frappe.get_doc(stock_entry_data) created_entry.insert() created_entry.submit() frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Material Issue auto-created: {created_entry.name}", indicator="green")
